subject.title: [优化建议] 添加结构化错误处理和智能重试机制

question: Which npm installer failures should OpenClaw auto-retry or auto-repair, and where should it only print remediation guidance?
rationale: The source shows a real diagnostics and recovery gap, but retry scope, npm prefix repair, and setup probe strictness can change install and upgrade behavior.

options.title: Define narrow retry and repair policy
options.body: Classify known npm failures, retry only transient idempotent network failures, and add platform-specific EACCES guidance or repair with focused Bash and PowerShell coverage.

options.title: Guidance-only diagnostics
options.body: Keep install behavior mostly unchanged but improve EACCES, ENOSPC, EBADENGINE, and network-error messages with clear next commands and docs links.

options.title: Keep current partial handling
options.body: Accept the current npm code/syscall/errno output and targeted stale-directory/EEXIST retries without adding a broader installer policy.

recommendation.title: Define narrow retry and repair policy
recommendation.body: Classify known npm failures, retry only transient idempotent network failures, and add platform-specific EACCES guidance or repair with focused Bash and PowerShell coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc has the broadest recent history across Bash, PowerShell, Docker, and Podman setup surfaces affected by this decision.
